title: AI Rate Proof Negotiation Room
oneLiner: A freelancer pricing room that converts AI-assisted speed into value proof instead of client discounts.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype called "AI Rate Proof Negotiation Room" for freelancers and small agencies pricing AI-assisted work. The app should help a freelancer turn a client brief into value drivers, human judgment checkpoints, AI-assisted task disclosure, risk ownership, scope boundaries, rate options, and a client-facing price defense memo. Required sections: project value intake, AI task disclosure ladder, human judgment proof board, scope creep boundary table, rate option builder, client objection simulator, proposal memo preview, and outcome and revision risk ledger. Use realistic freelance sample projects and make the app protect pricing confidence without sounding defensive. Design direction: use the `operator-dense` profile with compact negotiation panels, crisp contract-like sections, sharp objection status chips, and serious revenue-protection controls built for working freelancers.
